sources.title: Understanding biodiversity net gain
sources.facts: 14 July 2026 update: 0.2ha-or-below exemption starts 6 August 2026; NSIP BNG starts 2 November 2026.
sources.guard: Future-effective dates, exemptions and hierarchy require exact application facts; page alone is not site compliance.

sources.title: Statutory biodiversity metric tools and guides
sources.facts: Updated 2 June 2026; metric tools support BNG calculations and version updates do not change unit outputs.
sources.guard: A metric result depends on competent inputs and habitat evidence; publication availability is not an approved calculation.

sources.title: Statutory biodiversity credits
sources.facts: Credits are a last-resort route and spatial risk multiplier means one credit is worth 0.5 units.
sources.guard: Credit pricing or availability is not proof that a development can rely on credits or has met the gain hierarchy.

sources.title: Search the biodiversity gain sites register
sources.facts: Updated 2 June 2026; register shows accepted gain-site and allocation information.
sources.guard: Register presence is not ownership, availability for sale, sufficient units, legal enforceability or allocation to the target development.

sources.title: Register a biodiversity gain site
sources.facts: Updated 2 June 2026; application requires metric, legal agreement material and management/monitoring information.
sources.guard: Application or fee payment is not acceptance; accepted registration is not allocation to a development.

sources.title: Calculate biodiversity value with the statutory biodiversity metric
sources.facts: Updated 14 July 2026; statutory metric measures habitat value for mandatory BNG.
sources.guard: Metric outputs are not planning permission, habitat-condition verification, legal securing or monitoring compliance.

sources.title: Register a biodiversity site and allocate to a development
sources.facts: Updated 2 June 2026; registration and allocation can be submitted together for eligible landowners or representatives.
sources.guard: Submission is not acceptance and does not prove unit sufficiency, title, legal agreement validity or planning-condition discharge.

sources.title: Buying statutory biodiversity credits
sources.facts: Updated 2 June 2026; statutory credits are last resort and require upload of the official metric calculation.
sources.guard: Purchase workflow is not proof that credits were required, correctly calculated, accepted by the LPA or linked to a permission.
